pyqgis_plugin.name: Cross Section Editor
pyqgis_plugin.description: A plugin for editing cross section data. Primarily for ESTRY-TUFLOW cross-sections.
pyqgis_plugin.about: This plugin for QGIS provides an interactive tool for editing and managing cross-section data. Primarily for use with ESTRY-TUFLOW cross sections.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Search and Replace
pyqgis_plugin.description: Find and replace text across vector layer attributes, with regex, multi-field, and batch pair support.
pyqgis_plugin.about:
A dockable panel for finding and replacing text values in vector layer attributes.
Features: - Target multiple fields at once - Run multiple search/replace pairs in a single pass - Optional regular expression (regex) support with capture group substitution - Case-insensitive matching - Preview changes before applying them - Edits are staged — review in the attribute table and save when ready
